svg.text: How the money moves - the mechanism
The same six steps, plus the only two choices on the route that change what you end up with.
Which of the two depends on
A fund platform, or a broker
TWO DECISIONS THAT CHANGE THE OUTCOME
Decided by where the money arose, not by preference. Most people end up needing both.
Both start from the same rupee balance. They differ in what you need open first.
A fund platform, or the AMC
A broker, plus a demat account
Shares in demat, settled next day
Decided by day-count rules, not by
intention or by when you told anyone.
Status has to change at the bank, the
Check before you act, not after.

Every figure that would date this picture has been left out of it. The guide beside it carries the detail, and the guide can be dated.
